sustainability-msy.alt: A hump-shaped curve for a fish population with logistic growth and a carrying capacity (K) of 1,000 fish. The number of new fish added each year is near zero when the population is small, rises to a peak of 100 fish a year at 500 fish (half of K), and falls back to zero at 1,000 fish. Harvesting 100 fish a year while the population is held at 500 is the maximum sustainable yield.
